_comment: Identifiers that look like Bridge tool names but deliberately are not shipped tools.
Check 2 (fictional-tool) consults this list before reporting a finding.
Adding an entry is meant to be a deliberate act with a written reason. It is not a
silencer: if a name is genuinely fictional and presented as shipped, the honest fix is
to correct the prose, not to allowlist it. `index_drift` — the name that motivated this
tool — belongs in the docs' history, not in this file.
